coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of five ground-truth variable items are matched: JaxMARL/SMAX with fixed hardware and resources, MAPPO versus QMIX, and wall-clock time to a defined performance threshold. The task selection and normalized-score definition do not match.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design selects six maps rather than nine and includes maps with more than 10 units. It normalizes scores using random and expert baselines rather than dividing by each scenario's maximum score. It also adds IPPO and VDN. Training time is primarily reported in seconds for a fixed step budget, although time to an 80% win-rate threshold provides a semantic match to the required convergence-time measurement.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing both expected findings: PPO trains six times faster than Q-Learning and achieves higher normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios through greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
